symbols.name: PropertyBagSerialization
symbols.summary: Copies and persists scalar BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PropertyBag instances using the format defined by BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PropertyBagScalarCodec for each stored value.

symbols.name: Clone(PropertyBag)
symbols.summary: Copies the bag and its byte-array contents, retaining key spelling and case-insensitive lookup.

parameters.description: The optional bag to copy. Values other than byte arrays are kept as supplied.

returns.description: A new bag, including for an empty input bag, or null for null input.

parameters.description: The optional bag to copy. Values other than byte arrays are kept as supplied.

returns.description: A new bag, including for an empty input bag, or null for null input.

symbols.name: Serialize(PropertyBag)
symbols.summary: Serializes the bag as a JSON dictionary whose string values encode their original scalar types.

parameters.description: The optional bag of values supported by BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PropertyBagScalarCodec.

returns.description: The JSON dictionary, or null for a null or empty bag.

parameters.description: The optional bag of values supported by BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.PropertyBagScalarCodec.

returns.description: The JSON dictionary, or null for a null or empty bag.

symbols.name: Deserialize(string)
symbols.summary: Reads the persisted dictionary into a case-insensitive bag, restoring encoded scalar types and retaining unprefixed legacy values as strings.

parameters.description: The persisted JSON dictionary, or null or empty text.

returns.description: A new bag, empty when json is null, empty, or an empty JSON object.

parameters.description: The persisted JSON dictionary, or null or empty text.

returns.description: A new bag, empty when json is null, empty, or an empty JSON object.
